samples.description: A login screen, a fake load, and a 4x4 merge board — driven by InProcessGameDriver. Import this if your game's interactive elements are uGUI widgets.
Sign in, wait out a load, find a key and open a door — driven by PhysicsGameDriver. Import this if your game's clickable things are sprites with Collider2D.
A vault where the key sits behind a wall — driven by Physics3DGameDriver. Import this if your game's clickable things are 3D meshes with colliders, and to see how occlusion is caught.
